subject: Hosted API evaluation — next steps and quickstart
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Hosted API evaluation — next steps and quickstart

Hi Maria — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

What we covered
- Demo of Redwood Hosted API: generation, chat, embeddings, structured outputs
- Performance profiles and how to pick model variants for cost/latency
- Security basics: SOC 2, optional logging retention, VPC/private options for later

Your stated priorities
- Get a quick hosted eval working end-to-end this week so your engs can validate latency and quality
- Clarify rate limits and concurrency for our expected traffic
- Understand when Dedicated or Private would be recommended based on throughput/controls

Hosted API quickstart (test key + example)
- Quickstart doc: https://redwood.ai/quickstart
- Test API key (expires in 7 days): RWD-TEST-XXXX (created for your account)
- Example curl (generation):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer RWD-TEST-XXXX' 
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
    -d '{"model":"rwd-medium-1","input":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":150}'

Rate limits (Hosted eval)
- Default test keys: 60 requests/minute, 4 concurrent requests
- Production Hosted plans: configurable; we commonly support 300–1,000 rps with dedicated capacity or Reserved pools
- If you need sustained 100+ reqs/sec we typically recommend Redwood Dedicated for predictable latency and isolation

Security and data residency
- SOC 2 summary attached (SOC2-Summary-Redwood.pdf)
- Hosted API stores transient inference logs by default; you can opt out of logging or configure retention in the Console
- For stricter residency or on-prem requirements, we can discuss Private VPC or on-prem deployments

Next steps
1) Try the quickstart and run 1–2 representative calls from your service (I can reissue keys if needed)
2) Share expected throughput (req/sec, tokens/day) and any compliance needs (data residency, logging) — that will determine Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private recommendations
3) If it looks promising, I’ll loop in Marissa (Solutions Engineer) to scope a 2-week eval plan and provide cost estimates

I attached an evaluation plan template (fintechco-eval-plan.pdf) and the SOC2 summary. If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up tomorrow with Marissa to walk through the quickstart.

Thanks — looking forward to your notes.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

---
Redwood Inference — make LLM inference predictable and economical

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria@fintechco.com>

Date: 2026-12-05T16:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — next steps and quickstart

Thanks Aditya — this is great context and the curl example helps. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- SLA: do you offer any SLA on Hosted API (uptime/latency) or is SLA only available on Dedicated?
- Data residency & retention: our compliance team requires that production inference logs for PII be retained only in US regions and older than 90 days be deleted. Is that configurable in Hosted?
- Throughput: x-team expects a steady-state of ~150 req/s during peak (mostly short chat completions) and ~1M tokens/day.

If 150 req/s is above what Hosted comfortably supports, we’re open to Dedicated — curious on rough $/month ballpark for a 4-GPU reserved pool versus hosted usage pricing.

I can take a quick follow-up with Marissa and Neha — Marissa (cc’d) from our infra team will join.

— Maria
PM, FinTech Co

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T18:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — next steps and quickstart

Hi Maria — great questions, answered inline below.

SLA
- Hosted API: we provide uptime/latency targets in our commercial agreements, but formal SLA (financial credits) is typically included with Dedicated/reserved contracts. For evaluations, we can commit to an operational target and provide fallbacks.

Data residency & retention
- Hosted Console allows region selection for customers in supported regions (US/EU). Retention policies for inference logs are configurable per-account; you can opt out of logging or set 30/90/180-day retention. We’ll confirm the exact retention controls for PII with Security (attached SOC2 summary).

Throughput recommendation
- 150 req/s sustained (~9k rpm) is above typical Hosted trial allocations. For predictable latency at that scale we recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool). Rough sizing: a 4-GPU reserved pool (A10035G or similar) is commonly used as a starting point for that throughput with concurrency tuning and smart batching. Ballpark commercials: I’ll share a preliminary quote but expect mid 5-figures/month — I’ll ask Finance for a formal ballpark to share.

Next steps I propose
1) Quickstart run: please try the test key and send any errors — I’ll reissue if the key hits limits
2) I’ll loop in Marissa to scope a 2-week eval plan (I attached fintechco-eval-plan.pdf)
3) If you confirm sustained 150 req/s we can spin a Dedicated sizing call and provide a draft SOW/price estimate

Marissa — can you take point on a quick 30-min technical session with Maria and their infra lead to validate latency targets and the eval plan? I’m happy to join. Scheduling link: https://cal.com/redwood/solutions-review

Thanks — Aditya
